tablet.intro: A shared tablet (for example in the hallway) shows “Who are you?” with a picture tile per child. It gets no Yuvomi login, only its own KidsStar pairing. Open this address on the tablet:
tablet.name: Name
tablet.idleHint: After this time without use the child's session ends and the tablet shows “Who are you?” again.
tablet.openWarning: Without a picture code, anyone at the tablet can open every profile enabled there. If you don't want that, set a picture code per child below.
tablet.revokeText: The tablet loses all access at once and any running child session ends. To pair it again, add it anew.
tablet.codeExpires: The code is valid for 15 minutes and only once. It will not be shown again.
tablet.profilesIntro: Children who cannot read yet recognise themselves by the picture. Upload a photo or motif, or choose a symbol and a colour.
tablet.lookHint: Shown when no picture is uploaded. Choose something different for each child.
tablet.codeExplain: Four symbols, no letters or digits. After five wrong tries the profile is locked on that tablet for five minutes. Without a picture code anyone at the tablet can open this profile.
tablet.status.tablet_not_configured: Tablet mode is off: the KidsStar service has no API token (YUVOMI_API_TOKEN). See the guide.
tablet.status.tablet_token_invalid: Yuvomi rejects the KidsStar service's API token.
tablet.status.tablet_token_scope: The API token lacks the scope family:read.
tablet.status.module_forbidden: The API token sees KidsStar as switched off.
tablet.status.yuvomi_unavailable: The KidsStar service cannot reach Yuvomi.
widget.nothingWaiting: Nothing is waiting for a decision.
settings.parentRolesHint: Members with the family role dad, mom or parent and write access to KidsStar may approve, give stars and manage. Administrators always may.
